record.original_question: If a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of CP^n has infinitely many periodic orbits, must those periodic orbits satisfy the quadratic growth bound lim inf_{T -> +infinity} log P(T) / log T >= 2?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.Is it true that for a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism onCPn with infinitely many periodic orbits the inequalitylim infT→+∞ logP(T) logT ≥2holds?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{CP}^n$ denote the complex projective space of complex dimension $n$, equipped with the Fubini–Study symplectic form. Let $\varphi\colon \mathbb{CP}^n 	o \mathbb{CP}^n$ be a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism, i.e., the time-one map of a (time-dependent) Hamiltonian flow with respect to the Fubini–Study form. For each integer $T \geq 1$, define
$$P(T) := \#\{	ext{geometrically distinct periodic orbits of } \varphi 	ext{ with period} \leq T\},$$
where a periodic orbit of period $k$ is a point $x \in \mathbb{CP}^n$ with $\varphi^k(x) = x$, and two such orbits are identified if they coincide as subsets of $\mathbb{CP}^n$.

Assume that $\varphi$ has infinitely many geometrically distinct periodic orbits. Is it necessarily true that
$$\liminf_{T 	o +\infty}  rac{\log P(T)}{\log T} \;\geq\; 2 \,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question concerns the growth rate of the number of periodic orbits of Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms of complex projective space, refining lines of work surrounding the Conley conjecture and pseudo-rotations on $\mathbb{CP}^n$. While generic and special-case quantitative growth results are known (e.g., generic $k/\log k$-type growth, and structural results for pseudo-rotations on $\mathbb{CP}^n$), no source located in the search establishes the quadratic lower bound $\liminf \log P(T)/\log T \geq 2$ for all Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms of $\mathbb{CP}^n$ with infinitely many periodic orbits. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Hyperbolic Fixed Points and Periodic Orbits of Hamiltonian Diffeomorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Existence of infinitely many periodic orbits given a hyperbolic fixed point on certain monotone symplectic manifolds including CP^n.
status_evidence.claim: Provides existence (not quantitative growth) results for infinitely many periodic orbits on CP^n.

status_evidence.title: Conley Conjecture Revisited
status_evidence.snippet: Generic Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms have simple periodic orbits for every sufficiently large prime period, giving k/log k growth generically.
status_evidence.claim: Quantitative growth bounds for periodic orbits are only known generically, not for all Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms with infinitely many periodic orbits.

status_evidence.title: Hamiltonian Pseudo-rotations of Projective Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms of CP^n with the minimal number of periodic orbits.
status_evidence.claim: Boundary case (finitely many orbits) on CP^n is investigated; growth-rate question for infinite case is not resolved here.
